# Incidents

INC-1 Documentation/discovery steered consumers toward outdated policy: baseline d228711 and [assessment](../assessments/2026-09-13-app-kit.md) → Outcome: ADR-0019/0020/0021, root routing parity and explicit implementation states/MCP intent lookup. Real protocol/consumer-host checks prevent recurrence; broader G4 acceptance remains separate.

Shared chart renderers did not guarantee honest chart use. Evidence: Resume-as-Code's tests/lint/charts_test.go checks missing legends/sparkline context at real call sites. Would have caught it: composed meaning/encoding assertions. Outcome: I11, ADR-0025 and opt-in ui/vizcheck with Gallery canaries; geometry, browser and fleet adoption remain unproven.

INC-3 Theme regeneration omitted a shipped palette → commit 3faf384 adds gen:synthwave and its CSS generation diff to Taskfile.yml; I2 names that gate. All generated families, not only the default, require drift coverage.

MatDash metadata claimed an unperformed framework conversion (hardcoded Tailwind4 over Tailwind3 source) → Outcome: manifest-derived extraction tests in `internal/matdash/walk_test.go` and atomic rebuild regression in `cmd/appkit/matdash_atomic_test.go`; the recorded762-record rebuild corrected metadata without changing sources or claiming consumer conversion.

INC-5 2026-09-13 Consumer CSS generation wrote the kit terminal palette → `TestGenConsumerCSSDoesNotOverwriteKitTerminal` and explicit-output regressions; custom token inputs require an explicit terminal destination. Kit palette restored.

INC-6 2026-09-13 Theming advice discards paid design distinctions → ADR-0022, TestRetargetClassList and TestThemingMCPAdvisoryProtocol preserve original class bytes and contextual review notes; [paid-assets evidence](../assessments/2026-09-13-paid-design-assets.md). Rendered adaptation still needs review.

INC-8 2026-09-13 Consumer export overstates the forecast pending overlay. Refs: G3 in scope.md; TestAppKitSyntheticPendingOverlayAgreement20260913 in the linked fixture.

### INC-17 2026-09-13 Two signal owners can strand terminal shutdown
What: actual OS SIGINT intermittently hangs the terminal reference, while typed Ctrl+C quits normally. Evidence: owned-PTY transcript `appkit-terminal-pty-2eonpyu8`; pinned Fang v2.0.1 cancels the command context while Tea v2.0.9 can block sending InterruptMsg to its stopped event loop. Would have caught it: repeated process-level SIGINT, distinct from key bytes, with bounded exit and full terminal-restoration checks. Class: contract-broken Outcome: terminal-only `fang.WithNotifySignal()` leaves Tea as signal owner; shared non-TUI defaults stay unchanged. [Reproducible PTY receipt](../assessments/2026-09-13-terminal-reference.md#reproducible-pty-lifecycle-follow-up): 84 matrix assertions and 20 repeated SIGINT/restoration cases pass; deliberate ECHO drift fails. Twelve oracle/preflight/cleanup tests cover evidence integrity; graphical/consumer proof remains separate.

[Same-oracle evidence](../assessments/2026-09-14-gallery-analytics-quality.md):54 baseline failures,1,002 assertions pass afterward; full accessibility/consumer proof remains separate. Catalog recurrence 2026-09-16: 16–42px controls escaped the analytics-only check; `TestCatalogRenderedControlTargets` and [visible/disclosed target measurement](../assessments/2026-09-16-catalog-control-targets.md) reproduce 156 browser failures and pass the same 357-check oracle after repair. Header recurrence 2026-09-16: main-only checks missed crowded, undersized global navigation; `TestHeaderNavigationRetainsRouteParityAndNativeDisclosure` and [native mobile navigation/browser targets](../assessments/2026-09-16-gallery-header-and-missing-scale.md) retain 480 target failures and pass the repaired task. Physical touch/full accessibility remain separate.

INC-19 2026-09-14 Private evidence copies enter the Go package graph. What: root go test ./... compiles archived Gallery/RAC Go snippets and fails on absent helpers/imports. Class: contract-broken. INC-20 2026-09-14 Consumer's enhanced form leaks a secret without JS. What: RAC Settings omitted native method/action; Chrome submitted synthetic credentials by GET. ### INC-25 2026-09-14 Browser history mixes drafts and save versions
What: Chrome network Back restores old editable values with a fresh hidden version; stale drafts save303 instead of conflicting409, including without scripts. Class: contract-broken. Evidence: [same-oracle history matrix](../assessments/2026-09-14-shell-history.md);16 original mixed-snapshot failures,788 candidate checks pass. Would have caught it: actual network/BFCache history after a second-tab save, including native/no-script paths, not a synthetic pageshow event. Outcome: `TestShellDemoNativeHistoryDoesNotOptIntoMixedVersionRestoration` and opt-in32-lane browser proof retain native autocomplete-off plus coherent history/version checks. Other engines and pending-save cache remain unproven; no server-enforced or all-browser protection claim.

INC-26 2026-09-14 Navigation harness browser teardown errors. What: a repeat collected all24 navigation cases but emitted two non-runnable createElement/createHTML callback errors. Outcome: `TestCheckRejectsAdversarialTaskFacts/browser_error` and live receipt rejection prevent false passes; the collector observes errors before settings and uses an exact blank-page handoff before disabling scripts. Two final24-case runs pass; the suspected teardown cause is not a universal platform guarantee.
